current_statement: One composition regular-solution term can stand for graphite staging
proposed_model_or_boundary: Use multilayer gallery free energy with stacking/order coupling; keep the one-parameter model only as a labeled pedagogical reduction
required_data: multi-temperature low-rate OCV;operando XRD stage fractions;direction-specific data
code_impact: New thermodynamic backend and equilibrium minimizer; preserve current caller through an interface
identifiability_risk: Multiple parameter sets can fit one OCV curve; stage degeneracy and metastability remain
falsification_test: Reject transfer if held-out XRD stage fractions or phase boundaries are not reproduced together with OCV

current_statement: Rate has one unconditional effect on phase separation
proposed_model_or_boundary: Separate equilibrium landscape from reaction-limited mosaic and intraparticle dynamics; make rate effect conditional on exchange-current shape and heterogeneity
required_data: operando phase fraction and voltage at at least two rates and both directions
code_impact: Optional dynamic layer; no change to equilibrium-only API unless finite-rate claims are retained
identifiability_risk: Rate and heterogeneity are confounded by voltage-only data
falsification_test: Reject a universal rate statement if the same material switches mosaic/apparent-solid-solution behavior across protocols

current_statement: A fitted peak width uniquely measures one transport or microstructure parameter
proposed_model_or_boundary: Treat derivative width as an observation-model parameter generated jointly by phase kinetics, anisotropic diffusion, electrode transport, alignment, noise, and smoothing
state_variables: true U(x);particle/electrode state distribution;measurement grid;filter state
parameters: kernel width only as empirical descriptor;transport and geometry parameters kept separate
required_data: rate series;replicate cells;raw unsmoothed voltage;microstructure/transport orthogonal data
code_impact: Add explicit non-circular observation operator and sensitivity propagation
identifiability_risk: Severe many-to-one mapping from mechanisms to peak width
falsification_test: Reject microscopic width attribution when rate, alignment, noise, or smoothing perturbations reproduce the same change

current_statement: Graphite entropy is stage independent or has a 3-4 mV K^-1 scale
proposed_model_or_boundary: Use composition- and stage-resolved entropy coefficient; retain the approximately 0.28-0.30 mV K^-1 MCMB scale only as a material/protocol prior
required_data: equilibrated multi-temperature OCV on target graphite;calorimetry where available
code_impact: Pass T through all calls and interpolate kappa(x) with uncertainty
identifiability_risk: MCMB prior and atomistic Li entropy do not identify target-electrode total reaction entropy
falsification_test: Fail the transfer if held-out temperatures or high-lithiation data exceed stated uncertainty

current_statement: Derivative peaks are independent of acquisition and filtering choices
proposed_model_or_boundary: Record sampling, temperature, rate, alignment, non-circular filtering, derivative method, and sensitivity as part of the likelihood
state_variables: raw V-Q samples;sampling grid;filter state;noise model
required_data: raw repeated measurements and processing variants
code_impact: Replace circular FFT smoothing; expose preprocessing provenance
identifiability_risk: Filter and model width are confounded
falsification_test: Require stable peak claims under prespecified resolution/filter perturbations and boundary treatment

current_statement: A fitted finite peak mixture is a unique physical decomposition
proposed_model_or_boundary: Use nonlinear likelihood/profile or posterior geometry and compare competing model classes; do not use epsilon separation as a certificate
state_variables: all fitted parameters;latent component count;model indicator;discrepancy
required_data: multiple protocols and orthogonal phase observations
code_impact: Add identifiability report and model-comparison interface before physical labeling
identifiability_risk: Structural and practical non-identifiability under overlapping peaks
falsification_test: Fail physical attribution if profiles are unbounded, posterior correlations are near singular, or competing models predict equally well

current_statement: Exact staging voltages are universal constants
proposed_model_or_boundary: Attach graphite type, direction, temperature, rate, and structural evidence to every stage label
required_data: full Fujimoto and Weng texts;target operando XRD plus derivative data
code_impact: Metadata/table change only after full retrieval
identifiability_risk: Voltage features shift with material and protocol
falsification_test: Reject universal table if labels move or coexistence changes across direction and temperature

current_statement: Positive Omega in a one-composition regular solution represents Li-vacancy ordering at x=0.5
proposed_model_or_boundary: Remove the ordering identity; an x-only positive-Omega term is demixing curvature. Ordering requires eta or a symmetry-complete order-parameter vector
parameters: Landau/order couplings or CE-derived free energy;gradient terms for dynamics
required_data: transition temperature;superstructure intensity;phase boundaries;OCV
code_impact: Replace or relabel current interaction function; add minimization over eta only after data approval
identifiability_risk: Projecting eta out can create a false x-spinodal
falsification_test: Require a fixed-x path with changing eta and correct ordered variants; fail if x-only model is called ordering

current_statement: The O1-derived DOS amplitude and logistic g(E_F,x) with Delta x=0.05 are a microscopic LCO electronic entropy model
proposed_model_or_boundary: Delete the microscopic identity. Keep a localized feature only as an empirical branch-specific basis until a composition-resolved correlated-electron free energy or explicit electronic phase field is retrieved
parameters: empirical amplitude;center;width with covariance;no g_max/Delta x microscopic split
required_data: multi-temperature equilibrium OCV/reversible heat;composition-resolved spectroscopy or electronic free energy
code_impact: Replace electronic gate API with generic localized total-feature API; actual x and T required
identifiability_risk: Center-slope data identify combinations of amplitude and width, not both microscopic parameters
falsification_test: Reject microscopic labeling unless an independent source predicts composition width and held-out T dependence

current_statement: Evaluating only x=x_MIT and T=298.15 implements the documented composition- and temperature-dependent entropy
proposed_model_or_boundary: Pass caller x and T through every potential and derivative; use one width definition and a declared reference constant
required_data: analytic test cases;multi-x and multi-T fixtures
code_impact: Change function signatures/call graph and derivative tests in later implementation phase
identifiability_risk: Frozen center evaluation erases center/width meaning and can hide dead parameters
falsification_test: Analytic versus finite-difference derivatives and sensitivity to x_MIT,T must agree; gate-off invariance must hold

current_statement: Electronic, vibrational, and configurational entropy terms are separately identified by OCV and reversible heat
proposed_model_or_boundary: Treat measured quantities as derivatives of total free energy; name separate components only with orthogonal CE/MC, phonon, and correlated-electron priors
required_data: same-sample multi-T OCV;calorimetry;diffraction;phonons;spectroscopy
code_impact: Represent total model and optional prior-tagged components; report covariance
identifiability_risk: Gauge freedom permits compensating component functions with unchanged total observables
falsification_test: Fail component claims when alternate decompositions have identical total U and dU/dT

current_statement: Immediate recovery is needed before new atomistic data exist
proposed_model_or_boundary: Option A: branch-specific total U_ref(x) plus kappa(x) using constrained splines/small smooth bases; empirical localized features only
required_data: equilibrated multi-temperature branch-specific OCV and held-out ICA/DVA
code_impact: Low burden replacement backend; remove false labels; no phase prediction claim
identifiability_risk: Flexible splines can overfit and features remain nonunique
falsification_test: Hold out temperatures,cells,branches,composition windows; require derivative and smoothing robustness

current_statement: A textbook-level explicit ordering model can be built with current scalar x alone
proposed_model_or_boundary: Option B: sublattice or symmetry-complete Landau free energy g(x,eta,T), equilibrium minimization, common tangents, and CH/AC only if dynamics are claimed
parameters: a,b,c and coupling functions;gradient coefficients;mobilities only for dynamics
required_data: ordered structures;variant symmetry;transition temperature;diffraction;OCV
code_impact: Medium/high burden solver with local-minimum tracking and Hessian/common-tangent checks
identifiability_risk: Single eta may still be the wrong symmetry; coefficients weakly identifiable from OCV
falsification_test: Require correct degeneracy,transition temperature,superstructure intensity,OCV and no false projected spinodal

current_statement: A parameter patch can make the chapter predictive over the full LCO composition range
proposed_model_or_boundary: Option C: direct-LCO DFT configuration set, cluster expansion, SGC/umbrella Monte Carlo, differentiable G(x,eta,T) surrogate, then separate compatible vibronic/electronic additions
required_data: hundreds of configurations;multiple sizes/T/mu/seeds;held-out energies;phase/voltage/calorimetry
code_impact: New offline physics pipeline plus stable thermodynamic service
identifiability_risk: DFT method dependence, finite-size effects, surrogate error, and missing MIT/phonons
falsification_test: Require out-of-sample energies,correct ground states,finite-size convergence,phase diagram and held-out voltage

current_statement: Zero-K DFT energy, finite-T free energy, and measured dU/dT are interchangeable
proposed_model_or_boundary: Separate E0, F_conf, F_vib, F_el, phase minimization/convexification, and total partial-molar reaction entropy
parameters: method-tagged component functions and Li reference
required_data: calculated component data plus multi-T equilibrium measurements
code_impact: Add typed provenance/category fields; no implicit conversion
identifiability_risk: Different omitted terms can compensate in voltage fits
falsification_test: Reject any transfer whose source output and target thermodynamic quantity do not match

current_statement: One reversible O3 model can be extrapolated through deep delithiation and oxygen/stacking changes
proposed_model_or_boundary: Declare O3 reversible domain; treat H1-3/O1, oxygen redox/release, disorder and reconstruction as separate phase/degradation regimes
parameters: domain thresholds only when protocol/source matched
required_data: high-voltage structure,gas/spectroscopy and cycling data
code_impact: Add domain guards/labels only in later implementation
identifiability_risk: Thresholds depend on material engineering,rate,surface and history
falsification_test: Fail extrapolation if held-out structural or gas data enter an omitted phase before the claimed boundary

current_statement: Spinodal limits, equilibrium coexistence, kinetic hysteresis and signal width are interchangeable
proposed_model_or_boundary: Use convex hull/common tangent for equilibrium, Hessian loss for spinodal, explicit dynamics/history for hysteresis, and a separate observation operator for ICA width
parameters: free-energy and kinetic parameters kept distinct
required_data: equilibrium OCV;rate/rest scans;phase fraction;raw derivative data
code_impact: Separate solver outputs and result labels
identifiability_risk: Similar plateaus/peaks can arise from different categories
falsification_test: Reject label transfer when changing rate/rest or convexification changes the inferred boundary

current_statement: Silicon fraction can change denominator without an explicit basis
proposed_model_or_boundary: Declare fixed-total-active-mass replacement versus fixed-graphite-mass addition and propagate mass,capacity,density and volume bases
required_data: material formulation and electrode loading
code_impact: Add typed basis contract before all blend calculations
identifiability_risk: Different bases can fit the same normalized curve
falsification_test: Mass and capacity conservation must close under limiting pure-host and zero-Si cases

current_statement: A shared electrode potential proves separable G_int=0
proposed_model_or_boundary: Keep common electrochemical potential as an equilibrium condition; make G_int=0 an explicit conditional assumption; Si-C may require internal exchange
required_data: host-resolved equilibrium and exchange/relaxation data
code_impact: Expose separability flag and optional internal-host dynamics
identifiability_risk: Voltage alone cannot identify a cross free energy
falsification_test: Reject inferred G_int or separability if orthogonal host-state data are absent

current_statement: Equilibrium host fractions determine finite-rate current split
proposed_model_or_boundary: Add separate host transport,reaction currents,active areas,electrolyte/solid potentials and total-current closure; distinct internal Si-C exchange
required_data: host-resolved current/state data across rate and rest
code_impact: New finite-rate backend; preserve equilibrium-only mode with explicit label
identifiability_risk: Host kinetics,area and transport are confounded
falsification_test: Require current conservation,rest exchange and prediction across held-out rates/thickness positions

current_statement: Small-strain scalar correction is general for Si
proposed_model_or_boundary: Use multiplicative chemical-elastic-plastic/viscoplastic kinematics for general Si; label linear form a local truncation
required_data: geometry-tagged strain,stress,voltage and phase/path data
code_impact: New mechanics state/solver if general claims retained
identifiability_risk: Mechanism and parameter nonuniqueness across geometry/path
falsification_test: Reject generalization if finite-deformation model fails independent load/rate/geometry tests

current_statement: Equibiaxial thin-film slope transfers directly to hydrostatic particles/composites
proposed_model_or_boundary: Use Omega tr(sigma)/(3F) with declared sign/stress convention and geometry boundary; convert plane stress explicitly
parameters: Omega and mechanical parameters tagged by material/path/geometry
required_data: independent mechanical perturbation plus voltage;particle/composite stress validation
code_impact: Add stress adapter with geometry metadata
identifiability_risk: Stress and OCP branch effects are confounded without independent loading
falsification_test: Require predicted voltage jumps under independent stress perturbations and reject cross-geometry scalar transfer

current_statement: One single-valued U_Si(z) and one mechanism cover all cycles and cutoffs
proposed_model_or_boundary: Add crystalline/amorphous phase,path,first-cycle,Li15Si4 transformation and history state; keep mechanical and phase hysteresis mechanisms separate
required_data: phase-resolved spectroscopy/diffraction,cutoff series,relaxed voltage
code_impact: Stateful OCP/phase module
identifiability_risk: Multiple mechanisms reproduce branch separation
falsification_test: Reject universal curve when held-out cutoff/cycle/phase data show path dependence

current_statement: Elemental Si, SiOx, Si-C and Si/graphite are interchangeable labels
proposed_model_or_boundary: Define material identity and internal hosts; effective SiOx laws must state omitted conversion products and irreversible lithium
required_data: full formulation,first-cycle inventory,host-resolved data
code_impact: Separate material adapters
identifiability_risk: Effective fits hide conversion and contact states
falsification_test: Reject transfer if formulation/cycle inventory differs or component conservation fails

current_statement: Degradation can be folded into an equilibrium voltage offset
proposed_model_or_boundary: Track crack area,LAM,SEI original/crack surface,resistance,cyclable Li and named unresolved CBD/contact/porosity states
required_data: capacity,impedance,expansion,imaging and inventory across cycles
code_impact: Separate degradation states and conservation laws
identifiability_risk: Many degradation states produce similar voltage/capacity signatures
falsification_test: Require multi-observable prediction and mass/Li conservation; voltage-only attribution is insufficient

current_statement: Low-rate ICA/DVA uniquely separates Si and graphite degradation
proposed_model_or_boundary: Use protocol-matched host OCPs,balance/slippage and cross-sensitivity; add reference electrode or expansion/phase data where possible
required_data: three-electrode,expansion or host-resolved phase data plus low-rate curves
code_impact: Add uncertainty/cross-sensitivity report
identifiability_risk: Si/graphite/cathode modes cross-couple strongly
falsification_test: Reject absolute attribution if synthetic recovery or held-out orthogonal data exceed error bounds

current_statement: Processed ICA/DVA is treated as raw truth
proposed_model_or_boundary: Make acquisition,alignment,filtering,differentiation and uncertainty part of the statistical measurement model
required_data: replicates and processing perturbations
code_impact: Shared observation-model library
identifiability_risk: Preprocessing can mimic physical widths and shifts
falsification_test: Claims must survive prespecified processing sensitivity and boundary tests

current_statement: Local Jacobian rank alone establishes practical uniqueness
proposed_model_or_boundary: Use nonlinear profiles/posterior geometry,correlations and model comparison where multimodality matters
required_data: multi-protocol data
code_impact: Shared inference diagnostics
identifiability_risk: Method papers diagnose but do not prove this project's identifiability
falsification_test: Project-specific synthetic recovery and profiles/posteriors are mandatory

proposed_model_or_boundary: Include explicit model discrepancy and stress-test conclusions against discrepancy choices
required_data: replicates and structurally varied validation data
code_impact: Likelihood/model layer change
identifiability_risk: Discrepancy can absorb missing physics and destroy parameter meaning
falsification_test: Reject parameter interpretation when it changes materially across plausible discrepancy models

current_statement: More voltage data of the same type resolves all confounding
proposed_model_or_boundary: Select orthogonal protocols/observables: rate,temperature,impedance,expansion,reference electrode,phase/spectroscopy and mechanical perturbation

code_impact: No source-code change until design accepted
identifiability_risk: Additional same-manifold data may not improve rank
falsification_test: Accept added data only if predicted and observed information geometry improves for target parameters

current_statement: Normalized derivative shape alone fixes absolute capacity states
proposed_model_or_boundary: Retain absolute capacity,balancing/slippage and expansion alongside normalized derivative features
required_data: calibrated capacity and expansion/reference data
code_impact: Data contract extension
identifiability_risk: Normalization removes observability of scale and inventory
falsification_test: Synthetic and held-out recovery must distinguish scale,slippage and shape changes

current_statement: One low-rate voltage or impedance feature uniquely identifies silicon loss and a fixed silicon-dominant window
proposed_model_or_boundary: Allow degradation-dependent effective Si OCP deformation and transition SoC only inside a protocol-conditioned estimator; condition EIS on SoC and temperature; preserve explicit uncertainty and require orthogonal validation
parameters: deformation basis;capacity/balance parameters;noise and discrepancy;interaction terms
required_data: complete Wan model and supplements; raw constant-current data; matched EIS; reference-electrode, expansion, or host-resolved validation
code_impact: Future diagnostic layer and data contract; no thermodynamic backend change from targeted evidence alone
identifiability_risk: Effective OCP deformation, capacity loss, lithium inventory, cathode slippage, temperature, and preprocessing can compensate; statistical interaction is not microscopic identifiability
falsification_test: Fail material attribution when held-out pathway/cell/protocol data exceed uncertainty, when transition SoC is not stable under admissible preprocessing, or when orthogonal host evidence disagrees
